# Stage 01: Select And Tailor

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Select one primary PMI process and tailor its applicability and rigor for the project.

## Inputs

| Source | Section or file | Why |
|---|---|---|
| User | Request and project identity | Process goal and control root |
| Control root | `project-control.md`, `source-index.md`, `process-register.md` | Current state and source locations |
| Reference | `references/process-map.md` | Process ID, domain, focus area, PMBOK source |
| Reference | `references/tailoring-rules.md` | Applicability and rigor decisions |
| Reference | `references/artifact-management/process-artifact-map.md` | Artifact candidates relevant to the selected process |
| Prior run | Latest relevant run manifest, if supplied | Continuity and stale-output check |

## Process

1. Resolve the control root and confirm the project identity.
2. Select one primary process ID from the process map.
3. Add related process IDs only when their dependency is explicit.
4. Classify each selected process as `Required`, `Conditional`, or `Not needed`.
5. Record the project factors, rigor level, trigger, minimum output, and authority boundary.
6. Filter the process-artifact map to the selected process and record candidate artifact IDs without deciding need or treatment.
7. Create the process brief and run manifest. Do not change canonical records in this stage.

## Outputs

| Artifact | Location | Format |
|---|---|---|
| Run manifest | `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-manifest.md` | Markdown |
| Process brief | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/01-select-and-tailor/process-brief.md` | Markdown |

## Validation

| Check | Pass condition |
|---|---|
| Process | Every selected ID exists in the canonical map |
| Scope | One primary process is named |
| Tailoring | Disposition and rigor have reasons |
| Artifact scope | Candidate artifacts come from the selected process map; no need or treatment is decided yet |
| Authority | Any PM decision need is visible |
| Context | Only the selected recipe and relevant source sections are routed next |
| Setup | If the process register is absent, route to `setup/CONTEXT.md` before continuing |
